hero.description: Introduce a subject with one dominant visual and optional title.

single-focus.description: One primary visual with restrained camera motion.

full-frame.description: A supplied visual fills the canvas with cover/contain chosen by the scene.

close-up.description: Detail-led frame that may use normalized focus coordinates.

comparison.description: Two or more visual subjects compared in one frame.

measurement.description: A subject plus generated measurement line/label.

environment.description: Illustrated environment with optional foreground subject layers.

map.description: Map or distribution visual with generated labels/markers.

diagram.description: Explanatory diagram with generated callouts or arrows.

multi-object.description: Multiple supplied assets composed in the same scene.

fact-card.description: Typography/stat-led scene, optionally with one supporting asset.

cinematic-image.description: Large illustration driven primarily by crop and camera movement.
